items.title: 美國擬管制AI「算力」！中國AI透過海外數據中心租用輝達GB300、月之暗面遭點名
items.title_en: U.S. Plans to Regulate AI "Compute Power"! China AI Uses Overseas Data Centers to Rent Nvidia GB300, Moonshot AI Named
paras: 美國政府對中國人工智慧（AI）產業的晶片管制，正從「限制晶片出口」進一步延伸至「限制算力使用」。其中，中國AI公司月之暗面（Moonshot AI）更是直接被點名。
根據《The Information》報導，川普政府正在研擬一項針對AI晶片的新規則，目標鎖定中國AI公司透過海外數據中心，遠端使用美國先進AI晶片所提供的計算能力。
這項規則目前尚未公布具體條文，但其政策背景已逐漸浮現。《CNBC》日前報導，多家中國AI公司目前透過泰國、馬來西亞、日本等地的雲端服務商，取得包括輝達(NVDA-US) GB300在內的受管制晶片算力。
問題在於，美國現行出口管制主要追蹤的是晶片本身的「流向」，並未直接限制晶片算力遭海外客戶遠端租用的情況。

從管晶片到管算力　美國出口管制出現新缺口

美國對中國先進半導體的管制始於2022年10月7日。美國商務美國工業和安全局（BIS）當時發布《半導體出口管制臨時最終規則》，限制向中國出口超過600 TOPS性能的晶片及相關製造設備。
這項政策也迫使輝達調整對中國市場的產品策略。由於A100、H100無法直接出口中國，輝達在FY2023 10-K中披露，並因此認列4億美元庫存減值，後續推出A800、H800等符合當時管制要求的版本。
然而，管制範圍很快再次收緊。2023年10月，BIS將相關性能門檻下調至4800 TOPS，進一步堵住A800、H800等產品的管制漏洞；2024年11月，美國又將先進封裝與EDA軟體納入相關管制。
但過去這些措施的核心仍是「出口」、「再出口」及「轉讓」。換言之，只要先進晶片沒有實際被出口或再出口到中國，單純透過海外數據中心提供遠端算力，便可能落在既有規範之外。
這正成為美國政府目前試圖補上的缺口。

中國AI透過海外雲端取得算力　Moonshot AI遭點名

《CNBC》報導指出，中國AI企業正在利用東南亞及其他海外地區的雲端基礎設施取得先進晶片算力。
白宮官員Michael Kratsios 7月曾公開點名月之暗面（Moonshot AI），指其利用泰國一處數據中心內的GB300晶片。
此外，《CNBC》引述知情人士指出，字節跳動與新加坡雲端服務商Aolani合作，在馬來西亞取得輝達晶片提供的算力；阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 與騰訊(00700-HK) 也被指採取類似安排。
Aolani則表示，其客戶並不擁有支撐相關服務的晶片，也沒有未來取得晶片的權利或實體存取權；客戶對該公司的服務、基礎設施及技術進行的任何授權存取，都完全符合適用法規。
這也凸顯美國政府目前面臨的核心問題：從現行出口管制的文字來看，這類模式並不一定涉及晶片的出口或再出口，因此未必直接違反既有規定。

「遠端存取安全法案」已在眾議院過關

美國國會也已開始針對遠端算力存取建立新的法律框架。
《遠端存取安全法案》（Remote Access Security Act，RASA）今年1月已在眾議院通過，目前仍停留在參議院。法案計畫授權美國政府對受管制硬體與軟體的遠端雲端存取實施出口管制，同時要求雲端服務商執行客戶身分驗證（KYC）。
新美國安全中心技術與國家安全訪問學者Michelle Nie表示，美國晶片出口管制的目的，在於阻止中國利用美國先進晶片訓練尖端AI，而遠端存取模式正對這項政策目標形成威脅。
不過，她也指出，RASA本身只是賦予政府相關權限，後續仍需要BIS制定具體規則，包括哪些計算工作受到限制、哪些使用者不得存取，以及雲端服務商應如何執行有效的KYC。
AI政策與戰略研究所（AI Policy & Strategy Institute）計算政策團隊高級研究員Cassia Kim則認為，真正困難之處在於制定出既有效又能實際執行的規範。

東南亞大型數據中心恐面臨重新評估

如果美國最終將管制範圍從晶片本身延伸至算力使用，受到影響的可能不只是中國AI公司，海外雲端服務商及數據中心業者同樣可能面臨更高的合規要求。
白宮向《CNBC》表示，川普政府已建立「現代史上最嚴格的出口管制體系」，並仍將保護美國國家與經濟安全列為政策重點。
與此同時，全球數據中心產業仍處於快速擴張階段。仲量聯行估計，到2030年全球數據中心容量將增加一倍至約200GW。
在馬來西亞、印尼及泰國，目前規劃中的大型數據中心項目中，容量超過100MW的項目共有31個，但目前實際運作的僅有2個。
若未來美國開始對「算力跨境租用」進行管制，部分建立在跨境算力需求上的數據中心商業模式，可能因此需要重新評估。

中國本土算力替代壓力升高

面對美國持續收緊的先進晶片管制，中國也在加大本土半導體產業投入。
2024年5月，中國國家積體電路產業投資基金三期承諾投入約475億美元，主要投向中芯國際(00981-HK) 、長鑫科技(688825-CN) 、長江存儲及華為海思等企業。
在無法取得艾司摩爾(ASML-US) EUV設備的情況下，中芯國際利用DUV多重曝光技術實現7nm級製程量產，但在良率方面仍與台積電存在差距，5nm則被業界分析認為在商業上仍不可行。
華為昇騰910B、910C及910D則由海思設計、中芯國際代工。BIS在2025年5月發布的通用禁令10指南中認定，這些晶片使用美國技術且未獲授權，因此任何使用、出口、再出口或維修相關晶片的行為，都可能構成持續違反美國《出口管理條例》（EAR）。
SemiAnalysis估計，華為在2020年遭台積電(2330-TW) 斷供前，從台積電取得約290萬顆昇騰裸片。這批晶片屬於既有庫存，後續新增供應則必須依靠自身產線。

海外「算力外掛」空間可能遭進一步壓縮

即使晶片取得受到限制，中國AI模型的發展並未因此停滯。
月之暗面的Kimi K3、DeepSeek以及阿里巴巴近期推出的AI模型，仍在基準測試中展現出色表現。
《CNBC》引述業界人士指出，透過海外雲端服務取得先進計算資源，是中國AI模型能力提升的重要因素之一。
但隨著美國政府開始將注意力從「晶片在哪裡」轉向「誰正在使用這些晶片提供的算力」，這條海外算力通道正面臨新的政策壓力。
目前新規最終內容仍未確定，但可以確定的是，美國AI晶片出口管制的政策焦點正在擴大。過去以實體晶片流向為核心的管制框架，若進一步延伸至遠端算力存取，將使中國AI企業取得先進計算資源的方式面臨更大的限制。
對中國AI產業而言，海外算力可以提供額外的計算資源，但這條「外掛」通道本身並非穩固的長期基礎。隨著美國收緊管制，中國本土算力與自主供應能力的重要性也將進一步凸顯。
paras_en: The U.S. government’s chip controls on China’s artificial‑intelligence (AI) industry are moving beyond "restricting chip exports" to "restricting the use of compute power," and China’s AI firm Moonshot AI has been singled out.
According to The Information, the Trump administration is drafting a new rule on AI chips that targets Chinese AI companies that remotely use advanced U.S. AI chips through overseas data centers.

The rule has not yet been published with concrete language, but its policy background is becoming clearer. CNBC reported that several Chinese AI firms are currently obtaining regulated chip compute power, including Nvidia (NVDA‑US) GB300, from cloud providers in Thailand, Malaysia, Japan and other locations.
The problem is that current U.S. export controls mainly track the "flow" of the chips themselves and do not directly restrict the remote rental of chip compute power by overseas customers.

From controlling chips to controlling compute power – a new gap in U.S. export controls

U.S. restrictions on China’s advanced semiconductors began on Oct. 7, 2022, when the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued a temporary final rule limiting exports to China of chips and related equipment that exceed 600 TOPS performance.

The policy forced Nvidia to adjust its product strategy for the Chinese market. Because the A100 and H100 could not be exported directly to China, Nvidia disclosed in its FY2023 10‑K that it recorded a $400 million inventory write‑down and subsequently launched the A800, H800 and other versions that complied with the then‑current restrictions.

However, the scope of the controls tightened again quickly. In Oct. 2023, BIS lowered the performance threshold to 4,800 TOPS, closing loopholes for the A800, H800 and similar products; in Nov. 2024, the U.S. added advanced packaging and EDA software to the controls.

But these measures still focus on "export," "re‑export" and "transfer." In other words, as long as advanced chips are not physically shipped to or through China, providing remote compute power via overseas data centers may fall outside existing rules.
That gap is what the U.S. government is now trying to plug.

Chinese AI firms obtain compute power through overseas clouds – Moonshot AI singled out

CNBC reported that Chinese AI companies are using cloud infrastructure in Southeast Asia and other overseas regions to acquire advanced chip compute power.
White House official Michael Kratsios publicly named Moonshot AI in July, accusing it of using a GB300 chip located in a Thai data center.

CNBC also quoted sources saying ByteDance has partnered with Singapore‑based cloud provider Aolani to obtain Nvidia‑chip compute power in Malaysia, and that Alibaba (09988‑HK) and Tencent (00700‑HK) are alleged to have similar arrangements.

Aolani said its customers do not own the chips that support the services, have no rights to obtain chips in the future, and have no physical access; any authorized access to the company’s services, infrastructure and technology fully complies with applicable regulations.

This highlights the core issue facing the U.S. government: under the current wording of export controls, such a model does not necessarily involve the export or re‑export of chips, and therefore may not directly violate existing rules.

"Remote Access Security Act" passed the House

The U.S. Congress has also begun building a new legal framework for remote compute access.

The Remote Access Security Act (RASA) cleared the House in January of this year and now sits in the Senate. The bill would authorize the U.S. government to apply export controls to remote cloud access of controlled hardware and software, and would require cloud providers to perform customer identity verification (KYC).

Michelle Nie, a scholar at the New America Center for Technology and National Security, said the purpose of U.S. chip export controls is to prevent China from using advanced U.S. chips to train cutting‑edge AI, and that remote‑access models threaten that policy goal.

She added that RASA only grants the government authority; BIS would still need to issue detailed rules specifying which computational workloads are restricted, which users are barred, and how cloud providers must implement effective KYC.

Cassia Kim, a senior researcher with the AI Policy & Strategy Institute’s Computing Policy team, argued that the real difficulty lies in crafting rules that are both effective and practically enforceable.

Southeast Asian mega‑data centers may need to be reassessed

If the U.S. ultimately expands controls from the chips themselves to the use of compute power, the impact could extend beyond Chinese AI firms to overseas cloud providers and data‑center operators, which may face stricter compliance demands.

The White House told CNBC that the Trump administration has built "the most stringent export‑control regime in modern history" and will continue to prioritize protecting U.S. national and economic security.
At the same time, the global data‑center industry remains in a rapid expansion phase. JLL estimates that worldwide data‑center capacity will double to about 200 GW by 2030.
In Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand, 31 planned large‑scale data‑center projects exceed 100 MW in capacity, but only two are currently operational.
If the U.S. begins regulating "cross‑border rental of compute," business models that rely on cross‑border compute demand may have to be reevaluated.

Rising pressure for domestic Chinese compute substitution

Facing ever‑tighter U.S. controls on advanced chips, China is increasing investment in its home‑grown semiconductor sector.

In May 2024, China’s National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund Phase III pledged roughly $47.5 billion, mainly targeting SMIC (00981‑HK), ChangXin Memory (688825‑CN), Yangtze Memory and Huawei’s HiSilicon.

Without access to ASML (ASML‑US) EUV equipment, SMIC uses DUV multi‑patterning to mass‑produce 7 nm‑class wafers, but its yields still lag behind TSMC’s, and 5 nm is considered commercially unfeasible by industry analysts.

Huawei’s Ascend 910B, 910C and 910D chips are designed by HiSilicon and fabricated by SMIC. BIS’s General Prohibition 10 guidance issued in May 2025 deemed these chips to use U.S. technology without authorization, meaning any use, export, re‑export or repair could violate the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR).

SemiAnalysis estimates that before TSMC (2330‑TW) cut off supplies in 2020, Huawei sourced about 2.9 million Ascend die from TSMC. Those chips are existing inventory; any new supply must come from Huawei’s own production lines.

Overseas "compute add‑ons" may be further squeezed

Even with chip acquisition constraints, Chinese AI model development has not stalled.
Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3, DeepSeek, and recent Alibaba AI models continue to deliver strong benchmark results.
CNBC quoted industry insiders saying that obtaining advanced compute resources through overseas cloud services remains a key factor in boosting Chinese AI model capabilities.
But as the U.S. government shifts focus from "where the chips are" to "who is using the compute those chips provide," this overseas compute channel is facing new policy pressure.

The final content of the new rule is still undecided, but it is clear that the focus of U.S. AI‑chip export controls is expanding. Extending a framework that historically centered on the physical flow of chips to remote compute access would further restrict how Chinese AI firms obtain advanced computing resources.

For China’s AI industry, overseas compute offers supplemental resources, but the "add‑on" channel is not a stable long‑term foundation. As U.S. controls tighten, the importance of domestic compute capacity and self‑sufficiency will become even more pronounced.

items.title: 要搶NAND產能就必須「簽長約」？AI需求爆發、鎧俠擴產5兆日元藏「談判王牌」
items.title_en: To Secure NAND Capacity You Must "Sign Long-Term Contracts"? AI Demand Surge, Kioxia's 5 Trillion Yen Expansion Holds a "Negotiation Ace"
paras: 日本NAND快閃記憶體大廠鎧俠（Kioxia）與SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 近期公布截至2033會計年度的5兆日元擴產計畫，瑞銀（UBS）認為，這項計畫真正值得關注的並非擴產規模，而是鎧俠展現出「有能力擴產、但不急著立即執行」的策略，可能成為未來與超大規模雲端業者洽談NAND長期供貨合約（LTA）的重要籌碼。
隨著人工智慧（AI）模型持續擴大上下文長度，推理端對NAND的需求快速增加，目前尚未出現放緩跡象。
在此背景下，瑞銀預期2027年NAND市場供需將較2026年進一步緊俏，超大規模雲端客戶在長約談判中的議價空間可能受到壓縮，鎧俠則有機會藉此爭取更有利的合約條件。
根據目前公布的規畫，鎧俠與SanDisk合計將投入5兆日元，其中鎧俠負擔60%，SanDisk則出資40%。
在這筆投資中，約1.8兆日元已確定用於K3新工廠，相關土地整備工作已經啟動，預計於2030會計年度開始生產。不過，剩餘約3.2兆日元所對應的廠區，目前尚未對外公布具體位置。
投資支出將分成兩個階段進行。2027年至2029會計年度期間，3年合計投資金額維持先前公布的1.4兆日元，平均每年約4,500億至5,000億日元。不過，部分原本安排在202會計年度的支出將提前至2027及2028會計年度。
到了2030年至2033會計年度，年度投資額則可能大幅提高至約1.25兆日元。
瑞銀估算，這項投資計畫若逐步落實，可望讓鎧俠的332層BiCS10世代新增每月20萬至22萬片產能；至於4xx層世代，則可增加每月18萬至20萬片產能。
若以2028會計年度末月產能約35萬片作為基準，在全部投資到位後，鎧俠月產能有機會恢復至約55萬片。
瑞銀認為，在此情況下，鎧俠未來面臨市場占有率下滑的風險相對有限。此外，鎧俠也略微調高位元成長預期，從原本約20%上修至20%出頭。
瑞銀認為，這項擴產計畫對鎧俠而言，另一項重要意義在於強化與超大規模雲端業者談判NAND長期供貨合約時的籌碼。
對大型雲端客戶而言，AI運算需求快速增加，使確保未來NAND供應變得更加重要，因此自然希望鎧俠能提前增加產能。
然而，鎧俠目前釋放出的訊息並非立即大幅擴產，而是將未來的擴產能力、投資規模及時程攤在檯面上，同時保留較大的執行彈性。
在NAND供應可能持續吃緊的情況下，供應商若選擇暫緩釋出新增產能，市場議價權也可能進一步向供給端傾斜。
瑞銀因此判斷，鎧俠有望利用這項擴產計畫，在與超大規模雲端客戶洽談長約時爭取更有利條件。若客戶希望提前鎖定未來NAND產能，可能就必須在價格及合約期限等條件上向鎧俠讓步。
paras_en: Japanese NAND flash memory giant Kioxia, together with SanDisk (SNDKV-US), recently announced a 5 trillion yen expansion plan through the fiscal year 2033. UBS believes the noteworthy aspect is not the scale of expansion but Kioxia's strategy of showing "capacity to expand but no rush to execute immediately," which could become a key bargaining chip in future long‑term supply agreements (LTA) with hyperscale cloud providers.
As AI models continue to increase their context length, demand for NAND on the inference side is rising rapidly, with no signs of slowing down yet.

Against this backdrop, UBS expects the NAND market to become tighter in 2027 compared with 2026, potentially squeezing the negotiating leverage of hyperscale cloud customers in long‑term contract talks, while Kioxia could use this to secure more favorable contract terms.
According to the announced plan, Kioxia and SanDisk will jointly invest 5 trillion yen, with Kioxia shouldering 60% and SanDisk contributing 40%.

About 1.8 trillion yen of the investment is already earmarked for a new K3 fab, with land‑preparation work underway and production slated to start in fiscal 2030. The location of the remaining roughly 3.2 trillion yen worth of facilities has not yet been disclosed.

The capital outlay will be split into two phases. From fiscal 2027 to 2029, the three‑year total investment will stay at the previously announced 1.4 trillion yen, averaging roughly 450‑500 billion yen per year, although some spending originally slated for fiscal 202 will be pulled forward to fiscal 2027 and 2028.
In fiscal 2030‑2033, the annual investment could rise sharply to about 1.25 trillion yen.

UBS estimates that, if the plan is rolled out gradually, Kioxia’s 332‑layer BiCS10 generation could add 200,000‑220,000 wafers of capacity per month, while the 4xx‑layer generation could add 180,000‑200,000 wafers per month.
Using the roughly 350,000‑wafer monthly capacity at the end of fiscal 2028 as a baseline, full implementation of the investment could lift Kioxia’s monthly output to around 550,000 wafers.

UBS believes that under this scenario, Kioxia’s risk of losing market share is relatively limited. The company also nudged up its bit‑growth outlook slightly, revising it from about 20% to just over 20%.
UBS sees another important implication of the expansion: it strengthens Kioxia’s negotiating position with hyperscale cloud providers for long‑term NAND supply contracts.
For large cloud customers, rapidly growing AI compute demand makes securing future NAND supply increasingly critical, naturally prompting them to hope Kioxia will ramp up capacity ahead of schedule.

However, Kioxia’s current messaging is not about an immediate massive expansion; instead, it is laying out its future expansion capability, investment scale and timeline while retaining considerable execution flexibility.
If NAND supply remains tight, suppliers who choose to delay releasing new capacity could see market bargaining power shift further toward the supply side.

Consequently, UBS judges that Kioxia can leverage this expansion plan to obtain more favorable terms when negotiating long‑term contracts with hyperscale cloud customers. If customers wish to lock in future NAND capacity early, they may have to concede on price and contract length.

paras: 美國聯準會主席鮑爾釋出鷹派態度，市場預期9月升息的機率升高，衝擊美股周五盤面，加上MSCI(明晟)最新一季度調整將於周一(31日)生效，有可能在當天尾盤量價劇烈震盪，也令台股本周9月開局面臨雜音，台股交易員認為，輝達財報帶動的多方氣勢具一定的撐盤力度，再加上正處電子傳統旺季，即將公布的8月營收可期，因此，站上4萬6後若行情拉回，低接動能也不弱，先觀察外資回流的力道能否延續。
三大法人8月以來截至28日合計買超 3746 億元，其中外資買超達 3295 億元，也是連續兩個月大幅賣超後轉買。

外資呈現連4周買超，20個交易日來買超最多者依序為主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、 主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)、主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)、 元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)、元大台灣50(0050-TW)、南亞科(2408-TW)、陽明(2609-TW)、 華新(1605-TW)、元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)和統一(1216-TW)，顯然回補台股以主動式ETF為主軸。
台股交易員認為，市場預測在華許發言後聯準會9月升息機率升至50%，但基本面又有AI長多格局撐盤，因此，9月行情處多空交戰，不過度悲觀，區間整理中可望驚驚逐步走出新行情。
永豐投顧分析，輝達8月財報優於市場預期，其台灣供應鏈在出貨量增加且毛利率提升的情況下，台股整體 EPS 值得關注。
不過，從籌碼面來看，若大盤量能未能放大，短期內可能仍會拉回修正，若指數跌破 44900 點均線帶且連續數個交易日未能收復，則盤整格局延續，待籌碼重新沉澱後再行評估。
永豐投顧也統計，美國11月期中選舉年的選前三個月股市偏弱，在選後轉強，以 1990 年以來九屆選舉年來看，台股選前三個月(8月)開始到11月報酬中位數為負，九屆中僅三屆上漲，歷史分布隱含的路徑，為選前震盪整理、選後動能轉強。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell’s hawkish stance has raised expectations of a September rate hike, impacting U.S. equities on Friday. Coupled with the MSCI (Morningstar) Q1 adjustment taking effect on Monday (31st), the market may see sharp volume‑price swings late that day, adding noise to Taiwan’s September opening. Taiwanese traders believe that Nvidia’s earnings have provided a solid bullish push, and with the traditional electronics peak season approaching, August revenue is expected to be strong. Thus, after breaking 46,000, if the market pulls back, the momentum remains strong; the focus will be on whether foreign capital inflows continue to sustain the trend.

Since August, the three major institutional investors have accumulated a net purchase of 374.6 billion NTD through the 28th, with foreign investors buying 329.5 billion NTD—marking a shift from two consecutive months of large net selling to buying.

Foreign investors have posted four consecutive weeks of net buying. Over the past 20 trading days, the top net buyers were: United Microelectronics’ active Unified 50 (00403A‑TW), United Microelectronics’ active Taiwan Stock Growth (00981A‑TW), United Microelectronics’ active Future 50 (00991A‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), Nan Ya Tech (2408‑TW), Yang Ming (2609‑TW), Hua Shin (1605‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L‑TW), and Uni-President (1216‑TW). The focus is clearly on actively managed ETFs.

Taiwan traders expect that after the Chinese comment, the probability of a September Fed rate hike rises to 50%, yet the fundamental AI-driven bullish trend supports the market. September will see a battle between bulls and bears, but not overly pessimistic; a range‑bound consolidation could gradually lead to a new trend.

Yongfeng Securities notes that Nvidia’s August earnings surpassed expectations, and Taiwan’s supply chain saw increased shipments and higher gross margins, making the overall EPS of Taiwanese stocks worth watching.

However, from a position‑holding perspective, if market volume does not expand, a short‑term pullback may occur. If the index falls below the 44,900‑point moving average and fails to recover for several consecutive days, the consolidation pattern will persist. After positions settle, a new assessment can be made.

Yongfeng Securities also reports that in the first three months of U.S. midterm election years, the market tends to be weak, turning strong afterward. Since 1990, in nine election years, the median return from August to November has been negative, with only three of the nine years showing gains. Historically, this pattern implies pre‑election volatility and post‑election momentum.

items.title: 赫格塞斯擬二次召集數百名美軍高官赴匡提科！新軍令、川普是否現身受矚
items.title_en: Hegseth Plans a Second Call for Hundreds of U.S. Military Leaders to Quantico! New Military Orders, Trump’s Possible Attendance Under Watch
paras: 美國官員表示，國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）正考慮今年再次邀請數百名高階軍事人員前往匡提科陸戰隊基地（Marine Corps Base Quantico）聽取演說。去年秋季，赫格塞斯正是在該基地發表「不要再有大鬍子怪人」（no more beardos）的演說。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，去年9月，赫格塞斯在未事先說明原因、且通知時間相當倉促的情況下，下令全美將軍與海軍將領前往匡提科集合。這項安排令軍方高階官員感到意外，也在軍中引發部分不安。
赫格塞斯則利用這場罕見的集會說明其政策優先事項，重點包括反對他所稱的前政府「覺醒」政策，並強調五角大廈應重新將「戰爭作戰」視為唯一任務。
赫格塞斯當時表示：「長久以來，我們根本沒有做到這一點。軍方被愚蠢且魯莽的政治人物迫使將注意力放在錯誤的事情上。」
他並說：「從許多方面來看，這場演說是在修正數十年來的衰敗，其中有些問題顯而易見，有些則隱藏其中。」
美國官員表示，如果今年再次舉行相關活動，赫格塞斯可能利用匡提科這一場合再次說明其政策優先事項。其中一名官員透露，他也可能同步發布一系列針對軍方的新指令。
不過，目前仍無法確認會議的確切日期，也尚不清楚是否會如去年一樣，要求所有現役海軍將領與陸軍將領出席。
五角大廈發言人Joel Valdez則表示：「目前沒有任何事情可以宣布。」
自去年出任五角大廈主管以來，赫格塞斯便將扭轉前一屆政府推動的多元化與包容政策列為目標。他長期主張，這些政策損害美軍標準，並希望恢復一種將體能標準置於他所稱「覺醒」理念之上的軍事文化。
不過，他也受到專家及前政府官員批評，後者認為他正將美軍各軍種帶向明顯的黨派化方向。
去年由赫格塞斯主導、美國總統川普開場的活動中，兩人獲得軍方官員禮貌但冷淡的回應。根據嚴格規定，軍人不得參與或鼓勵政治活動，因此與會軍官在整場簡報期間始終面無表情地坐著。
川普當時則利用一場冗長演說，大力肯定政府動用軍事力量維持美國城市秩序的做法，並威脅將採取更多行動。
川普表示：「他們把舊金山、芝加哥、紐約、洛杉磯搞成什麼樣子，這些地方非常不安全，而我們將一個接一個把它們整頓好。而這將成為在座部分人士的一項重要工作。那也是一場戰爭，是一場來自內部的戰爭。」
目前尚不清楚川普是否會出席這場活動的第二次舉行。
赫格塞斯去年發表演說時，強調要重新強化軍方標準，並表示軍事人員將依照體能狀況與外表接受評判。赫格塞斯當時表示：「不專業外表的時代已經結束。不要再有大鬍子怪人。」
五角大廈同時發布11份備忘錄，列出川普政府對國防部的政策優先事項，其中包括新的體能與儀容標準。
赫格塞斯表示：「對於任何需要依靠身體力量執行戰鬥任務的職務，體能標準都必須維持高水準，而且必須不分性別。如果這代表某些戰鬥職務女性無法勝任，那就這樣。」
paras_en: U.S. officials say that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is considering inviting hundreds of senior military officers to Marine Corps Base Quantico this year for a speech. Last fall, Hegseth delivered a speech at the same base titled "no more beardos."

According to the Wall Street Journal, in September of last year Hegseth ordered all U.S. generals and naval leaders to gather at Quantico without prior explanation or adequate notice. The arrangement surprised senior officers and caused some unease within the military.

Hegseth used the rare assembly to outline his policy priorities, focusing on opposing what he calls the former administration's "awakening" policies and stressing that the Pentagon should once again treat "warfighting" as its sole mission.
Hegseth said at the time, "For a long time, we have not done this. The military has been forced by foolish and reckless politicians to focus on the wrong things."
He added, "In many ways, this speech is correcting decades of decline, some of which are obvious and some hidden."

U.S. officials say that if the event is held again this year, Hegseth may use Quantico to reiterate his policy priorities. One official revealed that he may also issue a series of new directives for the military at the same time.
However, the exact date of the meeting has not yet been confirmed, and it is unclear whether, like last year, all active naval and army leaders will be required to attend.
Pentagon spokesperson Joel Valdez said, "There is currently nothing to announce."

Since taking office at the Pentagon last year, Hegseth has made reversing the previous administration's diversity and inclusion policies a priority. He has long argued that these policies damage U.S. military standards and wants to restore a culture that places physical standards above what he calls "awakening" ideology.
However, he has faced criticism from experts and former government officials who say he is steering the armed services toward a clear partisan direction.

During the event last year, led by Hegseth and opened by President Trump, the two received polite but distant responses from military officers. Strict regulations prohibit soldiers from participating in or encouraging political activity, so the attending officers remained expressionless throughout the briefing.
Trump delivered a lengthy speech, strongly affirming the government's use of military force to maintain order in U.S. cities and threatening to take further action.

Trump said, "They turned San Francisco, Chicago, New York, Los Angeles into what they are, these places are very unsafe, and we will fix them one by one. That will be an important task for some of those present. It is also a war, an internal war."
It is still unclear whether Trump will attend the second iteration of this event.

When Hegseth delivered his speech last year, he emphasized the need to reinforce military standards and said that military personnel would be judged based on physical condition and appearance. Hegseth said, "The era of unprofessional appearance is over. No more beardos."
The Pentagon also released 11 memoranda outlining the Trump administration's policy priorities for the Department of Defense, including new physical and grooming standards.

Hegseth said, "For any job that relies on physical strength to carry out combat tasks, physical standards must remain high and must be gender-neutral. If that means some combat jobs are unsuitable for women, then so be it."

items.title: OpenAI切斷Cursor AI模型供應！SpaceX收購後合作破局、馬斯克回嗆「我根本不在乎」
items.title_en: OpenAI Cuts Off Cursor AI Model Supply! SpaceX Acquisition Fallout, Musk Fires Back "I Don't Care"
paras: ChatGPT開發商OpenAI週五（28日）表示，計畫停止向Cursor提供AI模型。Cursor是一款程式設計工具，其背後公司目前已由馬斯克旗下的SpaceX(SPCX-US) 持有。此舉也讓OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）與馬斯克之間長期激烈的競爭進一步升溫。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI在部落格文章中表示，之所以做出這項決定，是因為基於過去與馬斯克旗下企業的合作經驗，以及相關公司違反合約的情況，OpenAI無法確信SpaceX未來會按照服務條款使用其技術。
馬斯克則在週六（29日）凌晨透過X平台回應，表示「我根本不在乎」。他同時指控奧特曼與OpenAI總裁Greg Brockman「不值得信任」，並再次重申兩人「竊取了一家開源非營利組織」。
馬斯克與奧特曼多年前便已存在歧見，雙方的衝突今年進一步升高，並因馬斯克對OpenAI提起、金額達1,500億美元的訴訟而鬧上法庭。
在審判過程中，馬斯克的律師表示，馬斯克及其他證人曾作證指稱奧特曼是個騙子；OpenAI則主張，馬斯克曾試圖取得公司的控制權。
馬斯克過去曾指控奧特曼及OpenAI背離最初的非營利使命，為自身利益而「竊取慈善機構」。不過，美國聯邦陪審團今年稍早對馬斯克不利，認定他提起相關訴訟的時間已經太晚。
然而，Cursor共同創辦人、目前擔任SpaceX高層的Michael Truell在X平台表示，公司正與OpenAI團隊協商，希望解決這項問題。
OpenAI宣布決定數小時後，與OpenAI及SpaceX皆存在競爭關係、但目前仍與SpaceX維持合作的Anthropic共同創辦人之一Tom Brown透露了這項計畫表示，計畫增加運算資源，以支援Cursor上的Claude模型。。
OpenAI在部落格文章中表示，在馬斯克收購X後，該平台也違反與OpenAI簽訂的合約條款。
OpenAI進一步表示：「與SpaceX這類大型合作夥伴合作時，我們通常會依賴客製化合約，以確保對方遵守服務條款，並確保相關整合能在大規模使用的情境下維持安全性。」
OpenAI表示，已提出將2026年11月12日作為停止提供服務的日期，並指出OpenAI與Cursor之間的協議規定，在發生「控制權變更」後，OpenAI僅有有限的時間可以取消合約。
SpaceX今年6月宣布，將以全股票交易方式、以600億美元收購Cursor背後的新創公司Anysphere，並已於本月稍早完成這項收購。
paras_en: OpenAI, the developer of ChatGPT, announced on Friday (28th) that it plans to stop providing AI models to Cursor. Cursor is a programming tool whose parent company is now owned by SpaceX (SPCX-US) under Elon Musk. This move further heats up the long‑standing rivalry between OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Musk.

According to Reuters, OpenAI explained in a blog post that the decision was based on past collaboration experiences with Musk’s companies and breaches of contract, making it impossible to trust that SpaceX would use its technology in accordance with the service terms in the future.

Musk replied on Saturday (29th) early morning via X, saying “I don’t care.” He also accused Altman and OpenAI president Greg Brockman of being “untrustworthy” and reiterated that the two had “stolen from an open‑source nonprofit.”
Musk and Altman had disagreements for years, and their conflict escalated this year, culminating in Musk filing a $150 billion lawsuit against OpenAI that went to court.
During the trial, Musk’s lawyers testified that Musk and other witnesses called Altman a liar, while OpenAI argued that Musk had tried to seize control of the company.

Musk previously accused Altman and OpenAI of abandoning their original nonprofit mission to “steal from a charity” for personal gain. However, a U.S. federal jury earlier this year ruled against Musk, finding that his lawsuit was filed too late.
Cursor co‑founder and current SpaceX executive Michael Truell said on X that the company is negotiating with OpenAI’s team to resolve the issue.

A few hours after OpenAI announced its decision, Tom Brown, co‑founder of Anthropic—a competitor that still collaborates with SpaceX—revealed the plan to increase computing resources to support Claude models on Cursor.
OpenAI’s blog post noted that after Musk acquired X, the platform also violated the terms of its contract with OpenAI.
OpenAI added that when working with large partners like SpaceX, it usually relies on customized agreements to ensure compliance with service terms and maintain security at scale.

OpenAI stated that it has set November 12, 2026, as the date to cease service, noting that its agreement with Cursor allows only a limited window to terminate the contract after a “change of control.”
In June, SpaceX announced it would acquire the startup Anysphere, the parent of Cursor, in an all‑stock deal valued at $60 billion, and the acquisition was completed earlier this month.

items.title: 矽力-KY AI含金量升高 明年資料中心營收占比拚逾2成
items.title_en: Silicon Power-KY AI Value Rises, Data Center Revenue Share to Exceed 20% Next Year
paras: 電源管理IC廠矽力*-KY (6415-TW)釋出新展望，董事長陳偉表示，隨AI基礎建設投資持續升溫，半導體產能轉趨吃緊，電源管理晶片(PMIC)需求也進入上升週期，展望第三季，儘管筆電、通訊等部分終端需求偏弱，但資料中心需求快速成長，預期本季營收將較第二季續增，下半年將由資料中心與汽車電子扮演兩大成長引擎。
陳偉指出，公司過往第三季營運多半持平第二季或小幅成長，今年情況略有不同，筆電市場動能相對疲弱，但AI基礎建設需求明顯升溫，包括資料中心電源、通訊模組、儲存及主機板等應用皆快速成長，加上目前整體供需仍偏緊，預期第三季營運仍可維持向上走勢。
其中，資料中心將成為矽力*-KY未來數年最重要的成長來源。陳偉表示，公司資料中心相關產品涵蓋Vcore、eFuse、訊號鏈晶片，以及數位控制器、閘極驅動器與各類電源管理IC等，多項產品已獲得客戶導入，並將自第三、第四季陸續進入客戶端，尤其主機板相關應用更有望成為未來兩年成長最快的產品線之一。
在AI運算領域，矽力Vcore產品目前已於伺服器CPU及客製化ASIC平台進行驗證，部分客戶近期可望進入試產；SPS過去主要應用於通訊設備，今年已切入伺服器、AI ASIC及先進駕駛輔助系統(ADAS)市場，最快第四季試產，預計2027年開始貢獻營收。
隨新品陸續放量，矽力*-KY資料中心業務第二季營收占比已達約15%至16%，預期2027年占比有機會突破20%。由於資料中心相關產品毛利率普遍高於公司平均水準，隨營收比重持續提高，除了推升整體營收規模，也可望改善產品組合並提升中長期毛利率。
汽車電子則為下半年另一成長主軸。陳偉指出，雖然中國大陸整體車市表現仍相對疲弱，但當地品牌持續擴大海外出口，終端需求與去年同期相比並未明顯轉弱，公司受惠更多新產品進入量產、客戶數持續增加，車用產品線呈現全面成長。
此外，工業應用需求也保持強勁，除資料中心外，包括太陽能、儲能、電動車充電基礎設施及能源計量晶片等應用皆維持不錯動能；消費性市場雖部分客戶需求較弱，但隨新一代Gen 4產品競爭力提升，公司在客戶端市占率仍持續增加。
製程升級方面，矽力Gen 4產品導入速度持續加快，陳偉表示，尤其近期全球半導體供應鏈轉趨吃緊後，汽車客戶對新製程產品的採用意願較過去積極，公司維持第四季Gen 4營收占比達20%的目標。12吋產能目前主要用於生產Gen 4產品，明年則可能開始有部分Gen 5產品進入試產。
不過，供應鏈吃緊也對短期成本造成壓力。陳偉坦言，第二季毛利率略為下滑，主要是供應端成本上升速度較快，包括原材料價格上漲及產能瓶頸，使公司無法立即完全吸收成本壓力，因此今年毛利率仍可能呈現小幅波動。
陳偉認為，短期成本壓力並不改變中長期毛利率改善趨勢，隨Gen 4及資料中心高毛利產品營收占比逐步提高，產品組合將持續優化，毛利率仍有向上空間。目前供應鏈瓶頸也已逐漸由晶圓端轉向封裝測試，公司正持續擴充自有測試產能，有助縮短後段交期並提升供應彈性。
陳偉認為，目前全球半導體產能仍相當緊張，尤其8吋產能需求持續增加，電源管理IC正處於上升週期，公司過去一年已提前積極備貨、建立庫存，如今隨需求回升，相關布局正逐步轉化為營運成果。展望未來半年，AI資料中心需求仍將維持強勁，搭配車用新品放量與Gen 4滲透率提升，將成為公司下一階段營運成長的主要支柱。
paras_en: Power management IC maker Silicon Power-KY (6415-TW) released a new outlook, with Chairman Chen Wei stating that as AI infrastructure investment continues to heat up and semiconductor capacity tightens, the demand for power management chips (PMICs) is entering an upward cycle. Looking ahead to Q3, although demand for laptops and communications is weak, data center demand is growing rapidly, so revenue this quarter is expected to continue rising from Q2, with data centers and automotive electronics becoming the two main growth engines in the second half of the year.

Chen Wei noted that the company’s Q3 operations have usually been flat or slightly higher than Q2, but this year is slightly different: the laptop market momentum is relatively weak, yet AI infrastructure demand is clearly heating up, including data center power supplies, communication modules, storage, and motherboard applications, all growing rapidly. With overall supply and demand still tight, Q3 operations are still expected to trend upward.

Data centers will become Silicon Power-KY’s most important growth source in the coming years. Chen Wei said the company’s data center products cover Vcore, eFuse, signal chain chips, as well as digital controllers, gate drivers, and various power management ICs. Several products have already been adopted by customers and will gradually enter the customer side in Q3 and Q4, especially motherboard-related applications, which are expected to become one of the fastest-growing product lines in the next two years.

In the AI computing field, Silicon Power’s Vcore products have already been verified on server CPUs and custom ASIC platforms, and some customers are expected to enter pilot production soon. SPS, which was previously mainly used in communication equipment, has now entered the server, AI ASIC, and advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) markets, with pilot production as early as Q4 and revenue contributions expected to start in 2027.

With new products gradually rolling out, Silicon Power-KY’s data center business accounted for about 15% to 16% of Q2 revenue, and the share is expected to exceed 20% in 2027. Because data center products generally have higher gross margins than the company’s average, as the revenue share continues to rise, it will not only lift overall revenue scale but also improve the product mix and raise medium‑to‑long‑term gross margins.

Automotive electronics is another growth axis for the second half of the year. Chen Wei said that although the overall Chinese mainland car market remains relatively weak, local brands continue to expand overseas exports, and end‑user demand has not weakened significantly compared to the same period last year. The company benefits from more new products entering mass production and a growing customer base, with the automotive product line showing comprehensive growth.

Industrial applications also remain strong. In addition to data centers, applications such as solar, energy storage, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and energy metering chips all maintain good momentum. The consumer market is weaker for some customers, but with the competitiveness of the new Gen 4 products improving, the company’s market share in the customer side continues to grow.

Process upgrades: Silicon Power’s Gen 4 products are being adopted at an accelerating pace. Chen Wei said that especially after the global semiconductor supply chain tightened, automotive customers have been more proactive in adopting new process products. The company maintains a target of 20% of Q4 Gen 4 revenue share. The 12‑inch capacity is currently mainly used to produce Gen 4 products, and next year some Gen 5 products may begin pilot production.

However, supply chain tightening also puts short‑term cost pressure. Chen Wei admitted that Q2 gross margin slipped slightly, mainly because supply‑side cost increases outpaced the company’s ability to absorb them, including rising raw material prices and capacity bottlenecks, so gross margin may still fluctuate slightly this year.

Chen Wei believes that short‑term cost pressure does not change the medium‑to‑long‑term gross margin improvement trend. As the revenue share of high‑margin Gen 4 and data center products gradually increases, the product mix will continue to optimize, and gross margin still has upside potential. The supply‑chain bottleneck is gradually shifting from wafer to packaging and testing, and the company is expanding its own test capacity to shorten downstream lead times and improve supply flexibility.

Chen Wei believes that global semiconductor capacity remains tight, especially the demand for 8‑inch capacity continues to rise. Power management ICs are in an upward cycle, and the company has been proactively stocking and building inventory over the past year. Now that demand is rebounding, the related layout is gradually turning into operational results. Looking ahead to the next six months, AI data center demand will remain strong, coupled with automotive new product volume and Gen 4 penetration, which will become the main pillar of the company’s next operational growth.

items.title: 內外資齊力拱盤！法人：從權值股轉到中小型題材 台股Risk-on訊號亮燈
items.title_en: Foreign and Domestic Investors Rally Together! Corporations Shift from Large-Weighted Stocks to Small and Mid-Cap Themes – Taiwanese Stock Market Risk-On Signal Lights Up
paras: 近期台股重回多頭結構，外資轉買且內資活躍，資金由大型權值股擴散至中小型題材股，展現 Risk-on (風險偏好) 訊號。安聯投信指出，AI 仍是確定性最高的成長趨勢，Rubin 平台量產與強勁接單支撐長線動能，即便面臨美一般消費轉弱與地緣政治干擾，台股基本面依然堅實。建議透過主動式投資靈活配置，掌握輪動契機與企業獲利成長潛力。
安聯台灣大壩基金經理人蕭惠中表示，近期市場波動來自信心面與籌碼面，信心面被美債、升息、中東局勢、AI規格與出貨變化干擾，籌碼面則被信心面與持股成本左右；市場自4月來至今，AI股高低起伏，沒變的是基本面，但信心面與籌碼面顯現則在不同階段出現不同的解釋與行為。有品質的AI股可持續高歌，基本面轉佳的非AI股也會有擁護者，看好台股後市。
至於美國消費力道轉弱未來潛在可能對台股的影響？安聯台灣智慧基金經理人陳思銘表示，美國8月零售銷售出現近九個月首度下滑，零售下滑、勞動市場走弱、油價偏高與長天期公債殖利率居高不下，四項風險同時浮現，雖對部份傳產股有所影響，但無礙台股表現，主因AI供應鏈才是多頭重心，且就經濟部預期8月份外銷接單年增率可達60%以上來看，資通訊接單強勁逐以抵銷北美一般消費可能轉弱的影響。
對於聯準會政策走向又將如何牽動台股？陳思銘表示，7月底聯準會 以9比3維持利率在3.50%–3.75%，下次FOMC會議為9月15–16日，目前市場預期以維持利率不變為多數，以美國財政部都主動介入美債殖利率升高的議題並採取積極的購債行為來壓抑殖利率，我們認為維持利率不變是可能的決策，因此9月的FOMC對市場影響有限。
題材面來看，蕭惠中表示，美國AI巨頭重要科技財測優於預期，配合Rubin平台即將量產，市場重回AI正向輪動，其資本支出展望亦對AI投資起到關鍵作用，說明2027年AI硬體需求將維持逾五成的成長率，有助支撐AI供應鍵股價表現。就目前接單狀況，CoWoS以及HBM到2027年都供不應求，2028年也沒有平衡的預期。在非電題材部分，可留意無人機、生技醫療。
評價面部分，蕭惠中表示，產業成長階段看的是趨勢方向與獲利上修幅度；截至目前為止，2026年台股企業獲利成長率已上修至六成以上，且上修獲利個股數仍高於下修者，在方向不變、幅度增加沒有改變之前，評價影響相對較低。專注議題上可留意8月31日MSCI權重調整、新iPhone發表，AI晶片進度與規格變化。
安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆表示，台股後市有望受惠於Rubin量產、TPU新品上市與資金回流力道；但評價面、美債殖利率走高與地緣政治仍將持續牽動市場走勢。近期台股在資金持續於電子、金融與傳產間輪動，仍有利反覆消化漲多後的估值修正與洗清籌碼。
廖本隆指出，AI仍是目前最具確定性的產業成長趨勢，在AI、高效能運算(HPC)以及半導體長線需求持續擴張下，產業成長趨勢並未改變；建議投資上應將更加重視企業獲利成長實際落地情形與評價合理性。在此環境下，主動式投資透過靈活調整產業配置與精選具競爭優勢企業，有望掌握市場輪動機會，兼顧成長潛力與收益需求。
paras_en: Recently, the Taiwanese stock market has returned to a bullish structure, with foreign investors buying and domestic investors active, as capital spreads from large-cap weighted stocks to small- and mid-cap thematic stocks, demonstrating a risk-on signal. Allianz Investment Trust notes that AI remains the most certain growth trend, with the Rubin platform’s mass production and strong order flow supporting long-term momentum. Even amid weaker U.S. consumer spending and geopolitical disruptions, Taiwan’s fundamentals remain solid. They recommend flexible active investment to capture rotation opportunities and corporate profit growth potential.

Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund manager Hsu Hui-chung says recent market volatility stems from confidence and position aspects. Confidence is affected by U.S. Treasury, rate hikes, Middle East situation, AI specifications and shipment changes, while positions are influenced by confidence and holding costs. Since April, AI stocks have fluctuated, but fundamentals remain unchanged; confidence and position aspects manifest differently at various stages. Quality AI stocks can sustain high performance, and non-AI stocks with improving fundamentals also attract supporters, boosting expectations for Taiwan’s market.

Regarding the potential impact of weaker U.S. consumer strength on Taiwan’s market, Allianz Taiwan Smart Fund manager Chen Si-ming notes that U.S. retail sales fell for the first time in nine months in August. The decline in retail, a weakening labor market, high oil prices, and persistently high long-term Treasury yields present four simultaneous risks. While some traditional industry stocks are affected, they do not hinder Taiwan’s performance, as the AI supply chain remains the bullish focus. Moreover, with the Ministry of Economic Affairs expecting an export order growth rate of over 60% in August, strong ICT order flow offsets any potential weakening of North American consumer demand.

On the Fed’s policy direction and its impact on Taiwan’s market, Chen Si-ming says that at the end of July the Fed kept rates at 3.50%–3.75% with a 9-to-3 vote. The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for September 15–16, and most market expectations favor a rate hold. The U.S. Treasury actively intervenes to raise Treasury yields and adopts aggressive bond-buying to suppress yields. We believe a rate hold is a likely decision, so the September FOMC will have limited market impact.

From a thematic perspective, Hsu Hui-chung notes that U.S. AI giants’ technology metrics beat expectations, and with the Rubin platform set for mass production, the market returns to a positive AI rotation. Capital expenditure outlook also plays a key role in AI investment, indicating that AI hardware demand will grow at over 50% through 2027, supporting key AI supply stock prices. Currently, CoWoS and HBM will remain in high demand through 2027, with no balance expected in 2028. In non-electronic themes, watch unmanned aerial vehicles and biotech medical.

In terms of valuation, Hsu Hui-chung says that industry growth stages focus on trend direction and profit upside. As of now, Taiwan’s corporate profit growth rate for 2026 has been revised upward to over 60%, and the number of stocks with upward revisions still exceeds those with downward revisions. With direction unchanged and upside increased, valuation impact remains relatively low. Key topics to watch include the MSCI weight adjustment on August 31, the new iPhone launch, and AI chip progress and specification changes.

Allianz Taiwan High-Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A-TW) manager Liao Ben-long says Taiwan’s market will benefit from Rubin mass production, new TPU launches, and capital inflows. However, valuation, rising U.S. Treasury yields, and geopolitical tensions will continue to influence market trends. Recently, capital has continued to rotate among electronics, finance, and traditional industries, allowing for repeated absorption of post‑gain valuation adjustments and clearing of positions.

Liao Ben-long points out that AI remains the most certain industry growth trend. With continued expansion in AI, high‑performance computing (HPC), and semiconductor long‑term demand, the industry growth trend has not changed. He recommends focusing on actual profit growth implementation and reasonable valuation. In this environment, active investment that flexibly adjusts industry allocation and selects competitively advantaged companies can capture market rotation opportunities while balancing growth potential and income needs.

items.title: 美股狂歡恐在秋季煞車！美銀揭兩大潛在反轉變數
paras: 投資人近來無視伊朗戰爭與夏季科技股回檔，持續將美股推向更高水位，但美國銀行(BofA)策略師警告，這種情況終究會改變，而且可能就在今年秋季。
美銀以Michael Hartnett為首的策略團隊指出，逆勢投資人可能在未來幾個月迎來反擊多頭的機會。目前市場仍由「夏季共識」主導，也就是持續買進股票等被視為風險較高的資產。
策略師表示，投資人目前似乎不擔心經濟衰退、聯準會(Fed)升息、超大規模雲端業者(hyperscalers)削減資本支出，或民主黨在11月期中選舉同時拿下眾議院與參議院。市場依然押注企業獲利將持續成長、公債殖利率不會大幅飆升，以及經濟能夠維持擴張，即使通膨可能再度升溫。
Hartnett團隊指出，這也促使投資人持有股票與長天期投資級債券、押注短期政府債券價格下跌，同時買進美元。至於黃金與大宗商品，，則被視為規避這種市場共識所帶來的政策與政治風險工具。

伊朗戰爭若落幕 油價恐迎最後一跌

至於可能扭轉目前市場格局的因素，Hartnett團隊正密切觀察未來幾個月可能出現的兩項事件。
首先是伊朗戰爭可能結束。策略師認為，若衝突獲得解決，可能成為油價「最後一跌」的催化劑。
美國與伊朗就如何結束這場已持續六個月的戰爭陷入僵局，目前仍看不到明確的解決方案。理論上，若戰爭落幕，油價可能應聲下跌，消除市場對通膨的一項潛在憂慮，進而提振股市。
不過，這波漲勢可能只是曇花一現。隨著投資人不再關注戰爭，市場焦點可能重新轉向經濟疑慮，以及對人工智慧(AI)交易熱潮的擔憂。

期中選舉成第二道考驗

第二項可能挑戰美股多頭的因素，則是美國期中選舉。
根據Polymarket預測，目前民主黨贏得國會兩院的機率為50%。美銀的策略師團調表示，若共和黨失去參議院控制權，將顯示選民更重視生活成本與降低通膨，而不是減稅與放寬監管。
自川普2024年當選總統以來，美股大致持續走高。不過，市場目前認為華府政策環境有利企業，若共和黨在11月選舉遭遇重大挫敗，這種看法可能受到挑戰，也可能為股市帶來壓力。

華許面臨兩難：既要鷹派又要挺長債回購

Hartnett團隊也針對近期債市壓力提出看法，認為Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五在傑克森霍爾經濟研討會的演說，必須在兩項目標之間取得平衡。
策略師指出，華許必須在通膨議題上展現「可信的鷹派立場」，以維持Fed的公信力。但同時，華許也必須釋放支持財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)回購長天期公債計畫的訊號。
若華許成功拿捏平衡，可能帶動股票、其他風險資產甚至美元走高。
但美銀的策略師警告，若無法取得平衡，10年期美債殖利率可能重新「衝破」先前迫使貝森特宣布啟動公債回購計畫的水準。
當時10年期美債殖利率約為4.7%，30年期美債殖利率則約5.3%。若殖利率再度衝破這些關卡，債市壓力恐重新升高，並對美股多頭行情構成挑戰。

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉9月開局4萬6多空拔河 外資回流動能成行情一大關鍵
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: September Opens Above 46,000 as Foreign Capital Inflows Drive the Trend
paras: 美國聯準會主席鮑爾釋出鷹派態度，市場預期9月升息的機率升高，衝擊美股周五盤面，加上MSCI(明晟)最新一季度調整將於周一(31日)生效，有可能在當天尾盤量價劇烈震盪，也令台股本周9月開局面臨雜音，台股交易員認為，輝達財報帶動的多方氣勢具一定的撐盤力度，再加上正處電子傳統旺季，即將公布的8月營收可期，因此，站上4萬6後若行情拉回，低接動能也不弱，先觀察外資回流的力道能否延續。
三大法人8月以來截至28日合計買超 3746 億元，其中外資買超達 3295 億元，也是連續兩個月大幅賣超後轉買。

外資呈現連4周買超，20個交易日來買超最多者依序為主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、 主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)、主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)、 元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)、元大台灣50(0050-TW)、南亞科(2408-TW)、陽明(2609-TW)、 華新(1605-TW)、元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)和統一(1216-TW)，顯然回補台股以主動式ETF為主軸。
台股交易員認為，市場預測在華許發言後聯準會9月升息機率升至50%，但基本面又有AI長多格局撐盤，因此，9月行情處多空交戰，不過度悲觀，區間整理中可望驚驚逐步走出新行情。
永豐投顧分析，輝達8月財報優於市場預期，其台灣供應鏈在出貨量增加且毛利率提升的情況下，台股整體 EPS 值得關注。
不過，從籌碼面來看，若大盤量能未能放大，短期內可能仍會拉回修正，若指數跌破 44900 點均線帶且連續數個交易日未能收復，則盤整格局延續，待籌碼重新沉澱後再行評估。
永豐投顧也統計，美國11月期中選舉年的選前三個月股市偏弱，在選後轉強，以 1990 年以來九屆選舉年來看，台股選前三個月(8月)開始到11月報酬中位數為負，九屆中僅三屆上漲，歷史分布隱含的路徑，為選前震盪整理、選後動能轉強。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell’s hawkish stance has raised expectations of a September rate hike, impacting U.S. equities on Friday. Coupled with the MSCI (Morningstar) Q1 adjustment taking effect on Monday (31st), the market may see sharp volume‑price swings late that day, adding noise to Taiwan’s September opening. Taiwanese traders believe that Nvidia’s earnings have provided a solid bullish push, and with the traditional electronics peak season approaching, August revenue is expected to be strong. Thus, after breaking 46,000, if the market pulls back, the momentum remains strong; the focus will be on whether foreign capital inflows continue to sustain the trend.

Since August, the three major institutional investors have accumulated a net purchase of 374.6 billion NTD through the 28th, with foreign investors buying 329.5 billion NTD—marking a shift from two consecutive months of large net selling to buying.

Foreign investors have posted four consecutive weeks of net buying. Over the past 20 trading days, the top net buyers were: United Microelectronics’ active Unified 50 (00403A‑TW), United Microelectronics’ active Taiwan Stock Growth (00981A‑TW), United Microelectronics’ active Future 50 (00991A‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), Nan Ya Tech (2408‑TW), Yang Ming (2609‑TW), Hua Shin (1605‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L‑TW), and Uni-President (1216‑TW). The focus is clearly on actively managed ETFs.

Taiwan traders expect that after the Chinese comment, the probability of a September Fed rate hike rises to 50%, yet the fundamental AI-driven bullish trend supports the market. September will see a battle between bulls and bears, but not overly pessimistic; a range‑bound consolidation could gradually lead to a new trend.

Yongfeng Securities notes that Nvidia’s August earnings surpassed expectations, and Taiwan’s supply chain saw increased shipments and higher gross margins, making the overall EPS of Taiwanese stocks worth watching.

However, from a position‑holding perspective, if market volume does not expand, a short‑term pullback may occur. If the index falls below the 44,900‑point moving average and fails to recover for several consecutive days, the consolidation pattern will persist. After positions settle, a new assessment can be made.

Yongfeng Securities also reports that in the first three months of U.S. midterm election years, the market tends to be weak, turning strong afterward. Since 1990, in nine election years, the median return from August to November has been negative, with only three of the nine years showing gains. Historically, this pattern implies pre‑election volatility and post‑election momentum.

items.title: 矽力-KY AI含金量升高 明年資料中心營收占比拚逾2成
items.title_en: Silicon Power-KY AI Value Rises, Data Center Revenue Share to Exceed 20% Next Year
paras: 電源管理IC廠矽力*-KY (6415-TW)釋出新展望，董事長陳偉表示，隨AI基礎建設投資持續升溫，半導體產能轉趨吃緊，電源管理晶片(PMIC)需求也進入上升週期，展望第三季，儘管筆電、通訊等部分終端需求偏弱，但資料中心需求快速成長，預期本季營收將較第二季續增，下半年將由資料中心與汽車電子扮演兩大成長引擎。
陳偉指出，公司過往第三季營運多半持平第二季或小幅成長，今年情況略有不同，筆電市場動能相對疲弱，但AI基礎建設需求明顯升溫，包括資料中心電源、通訊模組、儲存及主機板等應用皆快速成長，加上目前整體供需仍偏緊，預期第三季營運仍可維持向上走勢。
其中，資料中心將成為矽力*-KY未來數年最重要的成長來源。陳偉表示，公司資料中心相關產品涵蓋Vcore、eFuse、訊號鏈晶片，以及數位控制器、閘極驅動器與各類電源管理IC等，多項產品已獲得客戶導入，並將自第三、第四季陸續進入客戶端，尤其主機板相關應用更有望成為未來兩年成長最快的產品線之一。
在AI運算領域，矽力Vcore產品目前已於伺服器CPU及客製化ASIC平台進行驗證，部分客戶近期可望進入試產；SPS過去主要應用於通訊設備，今年已切入伺服器、AI ASIC及先進駕駛輔助系統(ADAS)市場，最快第四季試產，預計2027年開始貢獻營收。
隨新品陸續放量，矽力*-KY資料中心業務第二季營收占比已達約15%至16%，預期2027年占比有機會突破20%。由於資料中心相關產品毛利率普遍高於公司平均水準，隨營收比重持續提高，除了推升整體營收規模，也可望改善產品組合並提升中長期毛利率。
汽車電子則為下半年另一成長主軸。陳偉指出，雖然中國大陸整體車市表現仍相對疲弱，但當地品牌持續擴大海外出口，終端需求與去年同期相比並未明顯轉弱，公司受惠更多新產品進入量產、客戶數持續增加，車用產品線呈現全面成長。
此外，工業應用需求也保持強勁，除資料中心外，包括太陽能、儲能、電動車充電基礎設施及能源計量晶片等應用皆維持不錯動能；消費性市場雖部分客戶需求較弱，但隨新一代Gen 4產品競爭力提升，公司在客戶端市占率仍持續增加。
製程升級方面，矽力Gen 4產品導入速度持續加快，陳偉表示，尤其近期全球半導體供應鏈轉趨吃緊後，汽車客戶對新製程產品的採用意願較過去積極，公司維持第四季Gen 4營收占比達20%的目標。12吋產能目前主要用於生產Gen 4產品，明年則可能開始有部分Gen 5產品進入試產。
不過，供應鏈吃緊也對短期成本造成壓力。陳偉坦言，第二季毛利率略為下滑，主要是供應端成本上升速度較快，包括原材料價格上漲及產能瓶頸，使公司無法立即完全吸收成本壓力，因此今年毛利率仍可能呈現小幅波動。
陳偉認為，短期成本壓力並不改變中長期毛利率改善趨勢，隨Gen 4及資料中心高毛利產品營收占比逐步提高，產品組合將持續優化，毛利率仍有向上空間。目前供應鏈瓶頸也已逐漸由晶圓端轉向封裝測試，公司正持續擴充自有測試產能，有助縮短後段交期並提升供應彈性。
陳偉認為，目前全球半導體產能仍相當緊張，尤其8吋產能需求持續增加，電源管理IC正處於上升週期，公司過去一年已提前積極備貨、建立庫存，如今隨需求回升，相關布局正逐步轉化為營運成果。展望未來半年，AI資料中心需求仍將維持強勁，搭配車用新品放量與Gen 4滲透率提升，將成為公司下一階段營運成長的主要支柱。
paras_en: Power management IC maker Silicon Power-KY (6415-TW) released a new outlook, with Chairman Chen Wei stating that as AI infrastructure investment continues to heat up and semiconductor capacity tightens, the demand for power management chips (PMICs) is entering an upward cycle. Looking ahead to Q3, although demand for laptops and communications is weak, data center demand is growing rapidly, so revenue this quarter is expected to continue rising from Q2, with data centers and automotive electronics becoming the two main growth engines in the second half of the year.

Chen Wei noted that the company’s Q3 operations have usually been flat or slightly higher than Q2, but this year is slightly different: the laptop market momentum is relatively weak, yet AI infrastructure demand is clearly heating up, including data center power supplies, communication modules, storage, and motherboard applications, all growing rapidly. With overall supply and demand still tight, Q3 operations are still expected to trend upward.

Data centers will become Silicon Power-KY’s most important growth source in the coming years. Chen Wei said the company’s data center products cover Vcore, eFuse, signal chain chips, as well as digital controllers, gate drivers, and various power management ICs. Several products have already been adopted by customers and will gradually enter the customer side in Q3 and Q4, especially motherboard-related applications, which are expected to become one of the fastest-growing product lines in the next two years.

In the AI computing field, Silicon Power’s Vcore products have already been verified on server CPUs and custom ASIC platforms, and some customers are expected to enter pilot production soon. SPS, which was previously mainly used in communication equipment, has now entered the server, AI ASIC, and advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) markets, with pilot production as early as Q4 and revenue contributions expected to start in 2027.

With new products gradually rolling out, Silicon Power-KY’s data center business accounted for about 15% to 16% of Q2 revenue, and the share is expected to exceed 20% in 2027. Because data center products generally have higher gross margins than the company’s average, as the revenue share continues to rise, it will not only lift overall revenue scale but also improve the product mix and raise medium‑to‑long‑term gross margins.

Automotive electronics is another growth axis for the second half of the year. Chen Wei said that although the overall Chinese mainland car market remains relatively weak, local brands continue to expand overseas exports, and end‑user demand has not weakened significantly compared to the same period last year. The company benefits from more new products entering mass production and a growing customer base, with the automotive product line showing comprehensive growth.

Industrial applications also remain strong. In addition to data centers, applications such as solar, energy storage, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and energy metering chips all maintain good momentum. The consumer market is weaker for some customers, but with the competitiveness of the new Gen 4 products improving, the company’s market share in the customer side continues to grow.

Process upgrades: Silicon Power’s Gen 4 products are being adopted at an accelerating pace. Chen Wei said that especially after the global semiconductor supply chain tightened, automotive customers have been more proactive in adopting new process products. The company maintains a target of 20% of Q4 Gen 4 revenue share. The 12‑inch capacity is currently mainly used to produce Gen 4 products, and next year some Gen 5 products may begin pilot production.

However, supply chain tightening also puts short‑term cost pressure. Chen Wei admitted that Q2 gross margin slipped slightly, mainly because supply‑side cost increases outpaced the company’s ability to absorb them, including rising raw material prices and capacity bottlenecks, so gross margin may still fluctuate slightly this year.

Chen Wei believes that short‑term cost pressure does not change the medium‑to‑long‑term gross margin improvement trend. As the revenue share of high‑margin Gen 4 and data center products gradually increases, the product mix will continue to optimize, and gross margin still has upside potential. The supply‑chain bottleneck is gradually shifting from wafer to packaging and testing, and the company is expanding its own test capacity to shorten downstream lead times and improve supply flexibility.

Chen Wei believes that global semiconductor capacity remains tight, especially the demand for 8‑inch capacity continues to rise. Power management ICs are in an upward cycle, and the company has been proactively stocking and building inventory over the past year. Now that demand is rebounding, the related layout is gradually turning into operational results. Looking ahead to the next six months, AI data center demand will remain strong, coupled with automotive new product volume and Gen 4 penetration, which will become the main pillar of the company’s next operational growth.

items.title: 內外資齊力拱盤！法人：從權值股轉到中小型題材 台股Risk-on訊號亮燈
items.title_en: Foreign and Domestic Investors Rally Together! Corporations Shift from Large-Weighted Stocks to Small and Mid-Cap Themes – Taiwanese Stock Market Risk-On Signal Lights Up
paras: 近期台股重回多頭結構，外資轉買且內資活躍，資金由大型權值股擴散至中小型題材股，展現 Risk-on (風險偏好) 訊號。安聯投信指出，AI 仍是確定性最高的成長趨勢，Rubin 平台量產與強勁接單支撐長線動能，即便面臨美一般消費轉弱與地緣政治干擾，台股基本面依然堅實。建議透過主動式投資靈活配置，掌握輪動契機與企業獲利成長潛力。
安聯台灣大壩基金經理人蕭惠中表示，近期市場波動來自信心面與籌碼面，信心面被美債、升息、中東局勢、AI規格與出貨變化干擾，籌碼面則被信心面與持股成本左右；市場自4月來至今，AI股高低起伏，沒變的是基本面，但信心面與籌碼面顯現則在不同階段出現不同的解釋與行為。有品質的AI股可持續高歌，基本面轉佳的非AI股也會有擁護者，看好台股後市。
至於美國消費力道轉弱未來潛在可能對台股的影響？安聯台灣智慧基金經理人陳思銘表示，美國8月零售銷售出現近九個月首度下滑，零售下滑、勞動市場走弱、油價偏高與長天期公債殖利率居高不下，四項風險同時浮現，雖對部份傳產股有所影響，但無礙台股表現，主因AI供應鏈才是多頭重心，且就經濟部預期8月份外銷接單年增率可達60%以上來看，資通訊接單強勁逐以抵銷北美一般消費可能轉弱的影響。
對於聯準會政策走向又將如何牽動台股？陳思銘表示，7月底聯準會 以9比3維持利率在3.50%–3.75%，下次FOMC會議為9月15–16日，目前市場預期以維持利率不變為多數，以美國財政部都主動介入美債殖利率升高的議題並採取積極的購債行為來壓抑殖利率，我們認為維持利率不變是可能的決策，因此9月的FOMC對市場影響有限。
題材面來看，蕭惠中表示，美國AI巨頭重要科技財測優於預期，配合Rubin平台即將量產，市場重回AI正向輪動，其資本支出展望亦對AI投資起到關鍵作用，說明2027年AI硬體需求將維持逾五成的成長率，有助支撐AI供應鍵股價表現。就目前接單狀況，CoWoS以及HBM到2027年都供不應求，2028年也沒有平衡的預期。在非電題材部分，可留意無人機、生技醫療。
評價面部分，蕭惠中表示，產業成長階段看的是趨勢方向與獲利上修幅度；截至目前為止，2026年台股企業獲利成長率已上修至六成以上，且上修獲利個股數仍高於下修者，在方向不變、幅度增加沒有改變之前，評價影響相對較低。專注議題上可留意8月31日MSCI權重調整、新iPhone發表，AI晶片進度與規格變化。
安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆表示，台股後市有望受惠於Rubin量產、TPU新品上市與資金回流力道；但評價面、美債殖利率走高與地緣政治仍將持續牽動市場走勢。近期台股在資金持續於電子、金融與傳產間輪動，仍有利反覆消化漲多後的估值修正與洗清籌碼。
廖本隆指出，AI仍是目前最具確定性的產業成長趨勢，在AI、高效能運算(HPC)以及半導體長線需求持續擴張下，產業成長趨勢並未改變；建議投資上應將更加重視企業獲利成長實際落地情形與評價合理性。在此環境下，主動式投資透過靈活調整產業配置與精選具競爭優勢企業，有望掌握市場輪動機會，兼顧成長潛力與收益需求。
paras_en: Recently, the Taiwanese stock market has returned to a bullish structure, with foreign investors buying and domestic investors active, as capital spreads from large-cap weighted stocks to small- and mid-cap thematic stocks, demonstrating a risk-on signal. Allianz Investment Trust notes that AI remains the most certain growth trend, with the Rubin platform’s mass production and strong order flow supporting long-term momentum. Even amid weaker U.S. consumer spending and geopolitical disruptions, Taiwan’s fundamentals remain solid. They recommend flexible active investment to capture rotation opportunities and corporate profit growth potential.

Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund manager Hsu Hui-chung says recent market volatility stems from confidence and position aspects. Confidence is affected by U.S. Treasury, rate hikes, Middle East situation, AI specifications and shipment changes, while positions are influenced by confidence and holding costs. Since April, AI stocks have fluctuated, but fundamentals remain unchanged; confidence and position aspects manifest differently at various stages. Quality AI stocks can sustain high performance, and non-AI stocks with improving fundamentals also attract supporters, boosting expectations for Taiwan’s market.

Regarding the potential impact of weaker U.S. consumer strength on Taiwan’s market, Allianz Taiwan Smart Fund manager Chen Si-ming notes that U.S. retail sales fell for the first time in nine months in August. The decline in retail, a weakening labor market, high oil prices, and persistently high long-term Treasury yields present four simultaneous risks. While some traditional industry stocks are affected, they do not hinder Taiwan’s performance, as the AI supply chain remains the bullish focus. Moreover, with the Ministry of Economic Affairs expecting an export order growth rate of over 60% in August, strong ICT order flow offsets any potential weakening of North American consumer demand.

On the Fed’s policy direction and its impact on Taiwan’s market, Chen Si-ming says that at the end of July the Fed kept rates at 3.50%–3.75% with a 9-to-3 vote. The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for September 15–16, and most market expectations favor a rate hold. The U.S. Treasury actively intervenes to raise Treasury yields and adopts aggressive bond-buying to suppress yields. We believe a rate hold is a likely decision, so the September FOMC will have limited market impact.

From a thematic perspective, Hsu Hui-chung notes that U.S. AI giants’ technology metrics beat expectations, and with the Rubin platform set for mass production, the market returns to a positive AI rotation. Capital expenditure outlook also plays a key role in AI investment, indicating that AI hardware demand will grow at over 50% through 2027, supporting key AI supply stock prices. Currently, CoWoS and HBM will remain in high demand through 2027, with no balance expected in 2028. In non-electronic themes, watch unmanned aerial vehicles and biotech medical.

In terms of valuation, Hsu Hui-chung says that industry growth stages focus on trend direction and profit upside. As of now, Taiwan’s corporate profit growth rate for 2026 has been revised upward to over 60%, and the number of stocks with upward revisions still exceeds those with downward revisions. With direction unchanged and upside increased, valuation impact remains relatively low. Key topics to watch include the MSCI weight adjustment on August 31, the new iPhone launch, and AI chip progress and specification changes.

Allianz Taiwan High-Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A-TW) manager Liao Ben-long says Taiwan’s market will benefit from Rubin mass production, new TPU launches, and capital inflows. However, valuation, rising U.S. Treasury yields, and geopolitical tensions will continue to influence market trends. Recently, capital has continued to rotate among electronics, finance, and traditional industries, allowing for repeated absorption of post‑gain valuation adjustments and clearing of positions.

Liao Ben-long points out that AI remains the most certain industry growth trend. With continued expansion in AI, high‑performance computing (HPC), and semiconductor long‑term demand, the industry growth trend has not changed. He recommends focusing on actual profit growth implementation and reasonable valuation. In this environment, active investment that flexibly adjusts industry allocation and selects competitively advantaged companies can capture market rotation opportunities while balancing growth potential and income needs.

items.title: 品牌建商在公辦都更勝出 大直「儒玉」、「藏璽」分別由皇昌及長虹拿下
items.title_en: Brand Builders Win Public Urban Renewal Projects; DaZhi "RuYu" and "CangXi" Secured by HuangChang and ChangHong
paras: 台北市住宅及都市更新中心擔任實施者的「大直儒玉」與「大直藏璽」兩大公辦都市更新案，順利完成評選，由皇昌營造(2543-TW)領銜皇昌福榮合作聯盟及長虹建設(5534-TW)分別獲選「大直儒玉」與「大直藏璽」最優申請人。

大直儒玉案最優申請人為皇昌營造領銜的皇昌福榮合作聯盟，整體建築規劃以「人本住宅、靜巷綠意、安全韌性」三大策略為核心，打造兼具宜居品質、自然綠意與安全韌性的現代住宅。預計更新後興建1幢2棟地上19層、地下4層建築，更新後樓地板面積約8779坪，結構升級為SC鋼骨造，並同步提升取得黃金級綠建築、低蘊含碳建築2級以上、耐震設計標章及國際WELL健康建築認證，另納入銀級智慧建築、建築能效1+級及新建住宅性能評估等標章與認證，預計創造逾100億元的不動產價值（未來實際規模及價值將依審議及權利變換計畫核定結果為準）。
大直儒玉案基地規劃集中留設開放空間，與鄰近公園相互串聯，形成住宅與自然環境間的綠色緩衝，並配置自行車位及友善步行動線，藉由綠廊連結周邊校園、公園及生活空間，營造兼具自然綠意、步行安全與社區共享的宜居環境。

大直藏璽案最優申請人長虹建設，整體建築規劃則以「森活共生」理念出發，打造豐富日常與提升居住品質的綠色雙塔，同時透過工法強化，築起大直安心居住防線。預計更新後興建1幢2棟地上24層、地下4層建築。更新後樓地板面積約1萬1,383坪，結構升級為SRC鋼骨鋼筋混凝土構造，進一步強化建築安全與整體性能，並升級導入黃金級綠建築及耐震設計標章，取得銀級智慧建築與建築能效1+級認證，住宅性能評估也達結構安全4級及無障礙2級，預計創造逾120億元不動產價值（未來實際規模及價值將依審議及權利變換計畫核定結果為準）。
大直藏璽案基地建物沿街側主動退縮，設置寬敞且連續的無障礙人行步道，銜接周邊學校與公園，形塑友善通學及散步綠廊，增加居民戶外交流空間；退縮範圍亦兼顧消防救災需求，有助提高災時救援效率及整體街廓防災安全。
台北市「大直儒玉」與「大直藏璽」兩大公辦都市更新案於2023年9月因鄰地基泰(2538-TW)施工不慎發生損鄰事件，經相關技師公會鑑定，兩案住家都出現牆壁裂縫、滲水、磁磚及裝修物破損等情形。考量建築物屋齡且經鄰地施工影響建築物狀態，市府隨即啟動公辦都市更新程序，於1個月內至社區召開說明會，期能透過都市更新方式改善居住環境，提升建築物使用安全。
經意願調查後，由北市府指定台北市住都中心擔任實施者，並公告更新計畫及劃定更新地區。本中心隨後積極協助住戶整合，透過駐點服務、多場座談會、建築需求調查與模擬選配，與住戶溝通凝聚共識，於去 年首次公告招商，惟未有申請人參與投標。
台北市住都中心因應市場環境變化重新檢討財務架構，並考量基地地質條件及施工風險，及持續辦理住戶溝通說明後，調整兩案招商條件，分別於今年3月及4月再次公告招商，經公開評選程序後順利決標。
paras_en: The Taipei City Residential and Urban Renewal Center, acting as the implementer, successfully completed the selection process for the two major public urban renewal projects, DaZhi RuYu and DaZhi CangXi. HuangChang Construction (2543‑TW) led the HuangChang FuRong Alliance and was chosen as the best applicant for DaZhi RuYu, while ChangHong Construction (5534‑TW) was selected for DaZhi CangXi.

The best applicant for DaZhi RuYu is the HuangChang FuRong Alliance led by HuangChang Construction. The overall building plan centers on three strategies: "human‑centric housing, quiet lane greenery, and safety resilience," creating a modern residence that balances livability, natural greenery, and safety. The project will build one two‑storey structure with 19 above‑ground floors and 4 below‑ground floors, with a post‑renewal floor area of about 8,779 ping. The structure will be upgraded to SC steel‑frame, and it will simultaneously pursue Golden‑Level Green Building, Level 2 or higher Low‑Carbon Building, seismic design certification, and international WELL Health Building certification. It will also include Silver‑Level Smart Building, Building Energy Efficiency Level 1+, and new residential performance assessment certifications, expected to create over NT$10 billion in real‑estate value (final scale and value will depend on review and rights‑transfer plan approvals).

The DaZhi RuYu site plan concentrates on retaining open space, linking with nearby parks to form a green buffer between residential and natural environments, and providing bicycle parking and pedestrian‑friendly routes. Through green corridors, it connects surrounding schools, parks, and living spaces, creating a livable environment that combines natural greenery, pedestrian safety, and community sharing.

The best applicant for DaZhi CangXi is ChangHong Construction. Its overall building plan is based on the "Forest‑Living Co‑existence" concept, creating rich daily life and improving residential quality with green twin towers. Construction methods are strengthened to build a safe residential line of defense in DaZhi. The project will build one two‑storey structure with 24 above‑ground floors and 4 below‑ground floors, with a post‑renewal floor area of about 11,383 ping. The structure will be upgraded to SRC steel‑reinforced concrete, further enhancing safety and overall performance, and will adopt Golden‑Level Green Building and seismic design certifications. It will also obtain Silver‑Level Smart Building and Building Energy Efficiency Level 1+ certifications, with residential performance assessment achieving Structural Safety Level 4 and Accessibility Level 2, expected to create over NT$12 billion in real‑estate value (final scale and value will depend on review and rights‑transfer plan approvals).

The DaZhi CangXi site builds a street‑side setback, creating a wide and continuous barrier‑free pedestrian path that connects nearby schools and parks, forming a friendly school‑to‑work and walking green corridor, increasing residents’ outdoor interaction space. The setback also considers fire and rescue needs, helping improve rescue efficiency and overall street‑level disaster safety.

In September 2023, the two public urban renewal projects, DaZhi RuYu and DaZhi CangXi, experienced neighbor damage incidents due to construction mishaps by neighboring Taiji (2538‑TW). After assessment by relevant engineering associations, residents in both projects reported wall cracks, water seepage, tile and decoration damage. Considering the building age and the impact of neighboring construction on building conditions, the city government immediately launched the public urban renewal process, holding community briefings within a month to improve living environments and enhance building safety through urban renewal.

After a willingness survey, the Taipei City government designated the Taipei City Residential and Urban Development Center as the implementer and announced the renewal plan and the designated renewal area. The center then actively assisted residents in integration, providing on‑site services, multiple forums, building needs surveys, and simulated selections, communicating with residents to build consensus. The first announcement for bidding was made last year, but no bidders participated.

The Taipei City Residential and Urban Development Center, responding to market changes, re‑examined its financial structure and considered site geology and construction risk. After continued resident communication and explanation, it adjusted the bidding conditions for both projects, re‑announcing them in March and April of this year. Through a public selection process, the projects were successfully awarded.

items.title: Vera Rubin與ASIC新品接棒放量 伺服器導軌台廠川湖及南俊下半年旺字當頭
items.title_en: Vera Rubin and ASIC New Products Drive Volume; Server Rail Makers Chuanhu and Nanjun See Strong H2 Outlook
paras: 隨著全球雲端服務供應商擴大建置AI基礎設施，伺服器導軌廠川湖(2059-TW)與南俊國際(6584-TW)在下半年伺服器出貨放量帶動下，營運持續走旺。由於次世代Vera Rubin平台與客製化晶片機櫃陸續進入出貨階段，加上先前供應鏈零組件缺料問題逐步獲得緩解，伺服器導軌產業全面迎來量價齊揚的成長週期。
產業領導廠川湖受惠AI伺服器強勁拉貨動能，上半年每股純益繳出110.96元亮麗成績。法人預期在下半年高階新品與客製化機櫃需求帶動下，川湖第三季與第四季營收皆有機會超越第二季水準。
面對龐大市場需求，川湖稼動率維持在70%至80%高檔，並提前擴產備戰，美國休士頓新廠預計9月投入量產，2027年下半年將有二廠接棒。因應未來二至三年的龐大訂單，川湖也規劃於第四季提早啟動川益三期與五期投資案，整體投資規模上看百億元。
南俊國際在經歷產品轉換期後，確立第二季為全年營運谷底，下半年在新品加入下重返升軌。為縮短新產品導入時程並搶攻市占，南俊國際採取擴增產品截面規格與強化功能專利兩大策略，在Vera Rubin世代已建立30多種規格，將與同業的進度差距縮小至一季以內。
在生產布局方面，南俊國際越南廠享有當地鋼材成本低20%至30%以及匯率結構優勢，第二季占合併營收比重已達20%，第三季可望突破30%。南俊國際採取越南優先投產策略，第四季將導入新專用產線，興建中的越南新廠預計於明年底完工，屆時整體產線規模將大幅擴充至20條。
隨著AI伺服器機櫃朝向高重量與高密度發展，滑軌的承重與公差要求更為嚴格，帶動產品單價顯著攀升。高階產品比重拉升將持續優化台廠產品組合與獲利表現。
paras_en: As global cloud service providers expand AI infrastructure, server rail manufacturers Chuanhu (2059‑TW) and Nanjun International (6584‑TW) are seeing continued strong operations in the second half, boosted by increased server shipments. The next‑generation Vera Rubin platform and customized chip cabinets are now entering the shipping stage, and earlier component shortages in the supply chain are gradually easing, ushering a growth cycle of rising volumes and prices for the server rail industry.

Industry leader Chuanhu benefits from robust AI server demand, posting an impressive earnings per share of NT$110.96 in the first half. Analysts expect that high‑end new products and customized cabinet demand in the second half could push Chuanhu’s Q3 and Q4 revenues above the Q2 level.

Facing massive market demand, Chuanhu’s utilization rate stays high at 70‑80% and it has expanded capacity early. A new plant in Houston, USA is slated for mass production in September, with a second plant coming online in the second half of 2027. To meet large orders over the next two to three years, Chuanhu plans to launch Phase 3 and Phase 5 of its Chuan‑Yi investment projects in Q4, with total investment reaching the tens of billions of NT$.

After a product transition period, Nanjun International identified Q2 as the annual low point and is rebounding in the second half with new products. To shorten new‑product introduction time and capture market share, Nanjun is expanding product cross‑section specifications and strengthening functional patents, having established over 30 specifications for the Vera Rubin generation, narrowing the gap with peers to less than a quarter‑year.

In terms of production layout, Nanjun’s Vietnam plant enjoys 20‑30% lower local steel costs and favorable exchange‑rate conditions; its share of consolidated revenue rose to 20% in Q2 and is expected to exceed 30% in Q3. Nanjun follows a Vietnam‑first production strategy and will introduce a new dedicated line in Q4; the new Vietnam factory under construction is slated for completion by the end of next year, expanding total line capacity to 20 lines.

As AI server cabinets move toward higher weight and density, slide‑rail load‑capacity and tolerance requirements become stricter, driving a notable rise in product unit prices. The increasing share of high‑end products will continue to optimize Taiwanese manufacturers’ product mix and profitability.

items.title: 金控雙雄法說登場、輝達財報優於預期、大立光再砸30.8億元購地 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Financial Group Leaders Hold Earnings Calls, Nvidia Beats Estimates, Largan Precision Buys Land for 3.08 Billion
paras: 金控雙雄富邦金控以及國泰金控法說會於本周接連登場，並雙雙釋出最新展望；輝達周三(26日)公告財報，結果優於預期，並預估2028年營收將年增7成；大立光周二(25日)再度宣布，以30.8億元向科宏工業購地，以下為本周大事回顧：

〈富邦金法說〉富邦人壽上半年TIS遠超140%目標 法人看好助攻金控股利發放 

富邦金控(2881-TW)周一(24日)舉行2026年上半年法說會，由總經理韓蔚廷主持。受惠於股市行情熱絡，富邦金上半年調整後 EPS 高達 13.17 元，韓蔚廷強調股利政策仍未改變，配發率維持 40-50%，在兼顧子公司資本需求與整體資本結構下，會將獲利成果穩定回饋給股東。富邦人壽上半年 TIS 遠高於 140% 的內部目標，法人預期可望大大提升主管機關核准股利發放的機率，為明年金控整體股利配發提供強大後盾。

〈國泰金法說〉國壽上繳股利展望樂觀 李長庚有信心：今年股利將比過去更好 

國泰金控(2882-TW)周五(28日)舉行 2026 年第二季法說會，由總經理李長庚主持。國泰金上半年稅後純益 765 億元，對保留盈餘影響數高達 1659 億元創歷史新高，前 7 月保留盈餘影響數更擴大至 1870 億元，盈餘分派量能相當充沛。總經理李長庚與經營團隊皆表示，在特別盈餘公積提存明確後，可分配量能充裕，對明年國壽上繳現金股利抱持樂觀展望。國泰金調整後淨值衝上 1 兆 5830 億元、每股淨值順利突破百元大關、達 101.2 元，李長庚直言，有信心國泰金2026年度股利將比過去更好。

輝達業績超預期 估2028財年營收增70% 

輝達(NVDA-US)周三(26日)盤後公布2027會計年度第二季(截至07/26)財報，業績亮眼，並給出高於市場預期的營收預測。
輝達第二季單季營收962.2億美元，調整後每股純益2.22美元，淨利翻倍達539.5億美元，優於市場預期。另外，財務長Colette Kress在與分析師的電話會議中表示，預期2028會計年度營收將成長70%。

大立光第四度出手以30.8億元向科宏工業取得大面積工業地產 

光學元件廠大立光 (3008-TW)繼在台中工業區購地接連出手後，在 6 月底至今並不斷加碼購入工業區內工業用地，周二 (25日) 並公布以30.8億元買下精密機械園區內科宏工業工業地產。

力成加速佈局CPO商機 Micro-Bump光引擎年底送樣驗證拚明年量產 

封測廠力成(6239-TW)周三(26日)舉辦先進封裝成果與產業趨勢分享會，董事長蔡篤恭與副總經理林基正親自向外界說明次世代矽光子與共封裝光學(CPO)的最新布局，指出旗下採用微凸塊（Micro-Bump）技術的光引擎有機會在今年底前少量出貨供終端客戶驗證，力拚明年邁向產能建置與量產階段。

國喬結盟日廠AWI入股宏廣新技 各持股35%跨足半導體特化藍海 

石化廠國喬石化(1312-TW)周二(25日)宣布，攜手日本工業氣體製造大廠愛沃特株式會社(AWI)，共同參與半導體特殊氣體製造商宏廣新技增資案，預計雙方各持股35%，成為2大股東，跨足台灣半導體特殊材料市場，開啟台日企業攜手布局台灣半導體的材料產業新篇章。

〈景氣燈號〉連亮8紅！41分持平、製造業回溫 經濟動能穩健但要留意4大不確定 

國發會周四(27日)公布7月景氣對策信號，綜合判斷分數為41分，與上周持平，燈號續亮紅燈，呈現連續第8個紅燈。其中，製造業營業氣候測驗點受惠AI需求持續強勁，由綠燈轉呈黃紅燈；貨幣總計數M1B受外資淨匯出影響，由黃紅燈轉為綠燈；另領先及同時指標持續上升，顯示國內經濟成長動能相當穩健；但仍需留意中東情勢發展、美國關稅政策變化、主要國家貨幣政策動向及財政不確定性等因素影響。

軍用無人機採購受限公務預算！經部喊話立院：恐挫傷274家台廠 產業需要穩定訂單 

立法院周四(27日)三讀通過強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例，但內容未採納行政院版本條文，經濟部對此表達深切遺憾。經濟部指出，通過版本要求新設特別委員會，並限制軍用無人載具採購僅能編列年度公務預算，此舉不僅忽視現行已順暢運作的跨部會機制，更有可能讓專業產業發展面臨政治化卡關風險，同時降低業者投入研發與擴產的信心。
paras_en: Fubon Financial Holding (2881‑TW) and Cathay Financial Holding (2882‑TW) held their 2026 first‑half earnings calls this week, each unveiling new outlooks; Nvidia announced its Q2 2027 results on Wednesday (26th), exceeding expectations and projecting a 70% revenue growth by FY2028; Largan Precision announced on Tuesday (25th) a purchase of industrial land from Kehong Industrial for 3.08 billion TWD, marking another major acquisition this week.

During Fubon’s first‑half earnings call, General Manager Han Weiting highlighted that Fubon Life’s TIS far surpassed the internal target of 140% for the first half, boosting the likelihood of dividend approval by regulators and strengthening the financial foundation for next year’s dividend payouts.

Cathay’s second‑quarter earnings call, led by General Manager Li Chang‑Geng, revealed a record 76.5 billion TWD net profit and a historic 165.9 billion TWD retained earnings impact, with a projected cash dividend outlook for 2026 that Li expressed confidence would surpass past years.

Nvidia’s Q2 2027 results posted a revenue of 96.22 billion USD and an adjusted EPS of 2.22 USD, with net income doubling to 53.95 billion USD, all above market expectations; CFO Colette Kress forecast a 70% revenue increase for FY2028.

Largan Precision’s fourth major land acquisition involved a 3.08 billion TWD purchase of Kehong Industrial’s industrial property within the Precision Machinery Park, following earlier acquisitions in Taichung’s industrial zone.

Lifeng Electronics (6239‑TW) announced on Wednesday (26th) that its micro‑bump optical engine could ship small batches to end‑customers by year‑end for validation, aiming for full‑scale production next year as part of its next‑generation silicon photonics and CPO strategy.

National Petrochemical (1312‑TW) announced on Tuesday (25th) that it, together with Japan’s Air‑Watts Industrial Gas (AWI), will each hold 35% of the newly capital‑raised semiconductor specialty gas company Hong‑Guang New Tech, marking a joint venture into Taiwan’s semiconductor materials market.

The National Development Council released its July economic signal on Thursday (27th), scoring 41 points—unchanged from last week—and continued to show a red light for the eighth consecutive week, with manufacturing business climate shifting from green to yellow‑red, while M1B money supply moved from yellow‑red to green.

The Legislative Yuan passed the National Defense Autonomy and Unmanned Vehicle Development Act on Thursday (27th), but the version adopted did not include the Executive Yuan’s draft; the Ministry of Economic Affairs expressed regret, warning that the new special committee and budget‑only procurement limits could politicize the industry and undermine confidence in R&D and expansion.

The same day, the Legislative Yuan’s third reading of the act was approved, but the Ministry of Economic Affairs cautioned that restricting military UAV procurement to annual public budgets could jeopardize the stability of orders for 274 domestic manufacturers, potentially harming the industry’s development.

items.title: 安永輔導創櫃吃下3成市佔率 攜手櫃買中心媒合8家新創秀肌肉
items.title_en: EY Guides New Companies to Capture 30% Market Share, Partners with OTC Center to Match 8 Startups
paras: 四大會計搶食輔導新創企業大餅，據統計創櫃板累計登錄292家公司，其中1/3來自安永所輔導。隨著創新產業加速發展與企業募資需求持續提升，櫃買中心與安永聯合會計師事務所昨(28)日共同舉辦「Bridge to Growth創新企業媒合會」。活動邀請創投、企業投資部門及產業夥伴，與8家潛力創新企業進行交流，同時邀請成功運用創櫃板資源並逐步邁向資本市場的埃爾思科技分享成長經驗，促成投資與策略合作機會，為企業拓展成長動能。
櫃買中心總經理陳麗卿表示，櫃買中心長期致力於建構健全的多層次資本市場體系，透過創櫃板協助企業在發展初期取得輔導資源、資金支持及市場關注。本次攜手安永舉辦創新企業媒合會，希望整合資本市場、產業及投資資源，為新創企業搭建高效交流平台，創造業務合作與募資機會，協助企業加速成長並邁向資本市場。
安永聯合會計師事務所所長傅文芳指出，台灣新創企業在成長過程中常面臨資金募集、人才招募及制度建置等挑戰，安永長期投入創新企業輔導，協助企業建立會計及內控制度，並透過創櫃板及資本市場規劃強化營運體質。截至2026年8月20日，創櫃板累計登錄292家公司，其中97家由安永輔導成功登板，占比超過3成。
安永輔導的企業中，已有10家轉列公開發行以上，目前9家登錄興櫃、1家上櫃、2家上市掛牌（含1家創新板公司）。安永已連續10年榮獲「創櫃板推動輔導績效獎」，未來將持續攜手櫃買中心及產業夥伴，協助企業鏈結資金、技術及市場資源，將創新成果轉化為長期成長動能。
本次參與媒合會的8家創新企業，涵蓋永續科技、人工智慧（AI）、生技醫療、長照服務及智慧製造等領域，包括海神全球、台灣碳梭科技、酈天永續科技、睿思智慧、壹鏡科技、利優生醫科技、錫盛事業及旭禾精。各家企業展現跨域創新能量，期待透過活動與創投及產業夥伴深化對接，創造投資與市場拓展契機。
paras_en: Four major accounting firms are competing to guide new companies, and statistics show that the OTC board has listed 292 companies in total, one‑third of which were guided by EY. With the rapid development of the innovation industry and the continuous rise in corporate fundraising needs, the OTC Center and EY jointly organized the "Bridge to Growth Innovation Company Matching Event" on the 28th. The event invited venture capital, corporate investment departments, and industry partners to interact with eight promising innovative companies, and also invited Elsi Technology—successfully leveraging OTC resources and gradually moving toward the capital market—to share its growth experience, facilitating investment and strategic cooperation opportunities and expanding growth momentum for enterprises.

The OTC Center's general manager, Chen Liching, stated that the OTC Center has long been committed to building a sound multi‑layered capital market system, helping companies obtain guidance resources, financial support, and market attention in the early stages through the OTC board. By partnering with EY for this innovation company matching event, the goal is to integrate capital market, industry, and investment resources, build an efficient communication platform for startups, create business cooperation and fundraising opportunities, and help companies accelerate growth and move toward the capital market.

EY's managing partner, Fu Wenfang, pointed out that Taiwanese startups often face challenges in fundraising, talent recruitment, and institutional building during their growth process. EY has long invested in guiding innovative companies, helping them establish accounting and internal control systems, and strengthening operational quality through OTC and capital market planning. As of August 20, 2026, the OTC board has listed 292 companies, of which 97 were successfully guided onto the board by EY, accounting for more than 30% of the total.

Among the companies guided by EY, 10 have already moved to public offerings, with 9 listed on the Emerging Board, 1 on the Main Board, and 2 on the Main Board listing (including 1 on the Innovation Board). EY has won the "OTC Board Promotion Guidance Performance Award" for 10 consecutive years, and will continue to partner with the OTC Center and industry partners to help companies link funding, technology, and market resources, turning innovative achievements into long‑term growth momentum.

The eight innovative companies participating in this matching event cover sustainable technology, artificial intelligence (AI), biotechnology and medical care, long‑term care services, and smart manufacturing, including Hai Shen Global, Taiwan Carbon Spool Technology, Li Tian Sustainable Technology, Rui Si Smart, Yi Jing Technology, Li You Sheng Medical Technology, Xi Sheng Enterprise, and Xu He Jing. Each company demonstrates cross‑domain innovation energy, and they look forward to deepening connections with venture capital and industry partners through the event, creating investment and market expansion opportunities.

items.title: AI算力海嘯超預期引爆！伺服器CPU爆發，點燃載板新戰局！
items.title_en: AI Computing Surge Exceeds Expectations, Sparking Server CPU Boom and New Battle for Advanced Boards!
paras: AI 算力狂潮不僅引爆 GPU 需求，伺服器 CPU 的規格升級更讓高階載板消耗量超乎預期，外資示警2026 至 2028 年供需缺口將飆至 19%，產能擴充不及確立了賣方市場格局，具備定價權的供應鏈正迎來結構性大繁榮。
〈伺服器CPU需求暴增，供需缺口逐年擴大〉
